description.en: Toggles a set of draw/pause bits on or off together (e.g. RPG character and camera rendering/updates), then suspends for one frame so the change takes effect.
True to clear (enable) the given bits, false to set (disable) them.
Optional bitmask of draw/pause bits to toggle (defaults to OFF_RPG_CHARA | OFF_RPG_CAMERA).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
